title: [DocDB] Tserver crash in UpdateTransactionWaitingForStatusRequestPB
body:
Jira Link: [DB-7611](https://yugabyte.atlassian.net/browse/DB-7611)
### Description


**Workload:**

[SqlWaitQueues](https://github.com/yugabyte/yb-stress-test/blob/maintain-aug/tools/sample-app/src/main/java/com/yugabyte/sample/apps/SqlWaitQueues.java)

**Workload command:** 
`Java -jar yb-stress-sample-apps-1.1.11-mc2.jar --workload SqlWaitQueues --drop_table_name daily_limit --nodes 172.151.29.31:5433 --transaction_type 2 --num_writes -1 --num_threads_write 15 --num_threads_read 0 --num_reads 0 --hikari_max_pool_size 30 --wait_on_conflict_all_customers true --wait_on_conflict_timeout 0 --password yugabyte --username yugabyte --run_time 1800
`
